name: Chicago Public Library paid summer teen internships
org: Chicago Public Library with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns work at a library branch helping patrons, promoting summer programs, organizing spaces and making book lists, then co-lead a library program. In 2026 interns were also trained to lead Artist's Studio in the Library with the Art Institute.
who_can_apply: Chicago residents attending a Chicago high school or equivalent (graduating seniors can apply), ages 16 to 19 on the first day (June 22 in 2026), with a Social Security number or ITIN.
deadline_text: The 2026 posting says applications are closed. 2027 dates not posted; the Chicago Youth Works summer application ran March 10 to May 29 in 2026.
how_to_apply: Log in to Chicago Youth Works, finish that application, choose After School Matters under Opportunities, then search library positions (program name CPL or your branch) in the ASM application. Branch staff interview in May.
notes: Positions were offered at every Chicago Public Library location. You can apply to many branches but be hired for one. Work permit: Illinois requires one only for under 16 and the minimum age here is 16. Questions: teenservices@chipublib.org.
